# Uma Farm Sweet Mosambi

> Uma Farm is a family-run sweet mosambi (sweet lime, Citrus limetta) orchard at Adalpura, Dhansura, Aravalli district, Gujarat 383310, India. The farm grows only mosambi, ripens the fruit on the tree without calcium carbide, uses drip irrigation, and sells wholesale to APMC mandi traders, juice bars and fruit sellers across Gujarat, with pickup at the farm.

Key facts:

- Business name: Uma Farm Sweet Mosambi (also "Uma Farm"; Gujarati: ઉમા ફાર્મ સ્વીટ મોસંબી)
- Location: Adalpura, Dhansura, Aravalli district, Gujarat 383310, India. Dhansura was part of Sabarkantha district until Aravalli district was formed in 2013.
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/2VBfWCgWzmzpPiWw8
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 94260 40220
- Hours: every day, 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM
- Product: sweet mosambi (sweet lime), sold per crate or per kg. Prices follow fruit grade, quantity and the current APMC mandi rate, so there is no fixed public price list. Buyers get the day's rate on WhatsApp.
- Farming: 20 x 20 ft tree spacing, drip irrigation, seasonal pruning, hand picking in the early morning, no chemical ripening.
- Buyers: APMC mandi traders and commission agents (Ahmedabad, Himmatnagar, Modasa, Vadodara, Surat), juice bars and juice centres, fruit shops and vendors, produce aggregators, and direct buyers at the farm.
- How to order: send quantity and city on WhatsApp (https://wa.me/919426040220) or use the inquiry form on the contact page.
